title: The parking problem
exact_target: Build a microscopic model explaining the different random-matrix spacing statistics observed for parked cars.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000009 (AMR-079-0009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 9.

status_qualification: The source refers to empirical spacing studies by Šeba and others. A theorem for the classical random sequential adsorption model alone would be a different target unless it explains those observations.
